messages:
ryan_sec: Noticed several premerge SAST/DAST pipelines started erroring with KMS decrypt failures after yesterday's key cleanup. Error looks like 'permission denied'. Anyone who changed keystore IAM?

lina_ci: That was my cleanup run. I removed an old group binding and consolidated to the new service-role. I thought dev-scanner SA was included but maybe not. I'm looking now.

infra-bot: [deploy-hook] change: keystore/ci-key update applied by lina_ci at 2026-03-21T21:04Z. Diff: removed binding group:keystore-readers@example.com.

dev-scanner: build: 403 decrypt error: "cryptoKeyVersionAccessDenied" on projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/ci-scanner-key. Full log: https://ci.redwood.internal/logs/7832

kat_prodsec: Quick triage runbook: 1) confirm which principle is failing (serviceAccount vs group) 2) query keystore audit logs 3) short-lived grant to unblock CI if needed 4) longer-term: add keystore IAM verification to premerge gate.

ryan_sec: Run this audit query to capture denies: resource.type="kms_crypto_key" AND protoPayload.methodName="Decrypt" AND protoPayload.authorizationInfo.permission="cloudkms.cryptoKeys.decrypt" AND timestamp>="2026-03-21T20:30:00Z" AND timestamp<="2026-03-21T22:30:00Z". Include principalEmail filter if you want single SA.

lina_ci: Confirmed: logs show DENIED for serviceAccount:dev-scanner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com at 2026-03-21T21:05:12Z. My change removed the group that indirectly granted the role. My bad.

kat_prodsec: Can we patch quickly? Best practice: ephemeral IAM bindings via the grant service. Do that and re-run blocked PRs. Also create a post-change checklist so infra changes run a keystore check automatically.

lina_ci: Applying ephemeral grant now for 30 minutes. Command: `./tools/ephemeral-grant grant --member=serviceAccount:dev-scanner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --resource=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/ci-scanner-key --duration=30m`

keystore-bot: [notice] Ephemeral grant created id=eg-9921 expires=2026-03-21T21:35:00Z. Principal: dev-scanner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com Role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter.

dev-scanner: Re-run queued — decrypts succeeding now, SAST job advanced to analysis step. Two repos still blocked by unrelated test flakes.

ryan_sec: Follow-ups: - lina_ci: add a CLI preflight in your keystore-change PR that runs the decrypt audit check against the impacted service accounts - infra-team: add alerting for IAM policy changes on keystore resources (policy-drift) - kat_prodsec: I'll start a short postmortem stub and assign owners for the follow-ups.

lina_ci: I'll add the preflight hook and update the PR template to require calling `./tools/keystore-verify --principals dev-scanner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` before merging.

kat_prodsec: Also add an entry to the secure-sdlc runbook documenting ephemeral grant use and the rollback guidance (revoke if CI doesn't stabilize).

ryan_sec: Good. Last note: ensure the audit query snippet and one sample denied log entry are attached to the PM ticket so we can track recurrence. Closing this triage unless someone sees more fails.
